what: A blurred (4px) 10px light dot appears on the first mouse move, trails behind by 1/6 of the remaining distance each frame, and sits over light surfaces like light using a screen blend. Over links it shrinks in diameter at the same pace until it vanishes, then returns when you leave
ease: Approaches 1/6 per frame + CSS transition .2s ease

options.ease: Closes in by 1/ease of the remaining distance each frame (position, opacity and diameter alike), default 6
options.link: Diameter multiplier over a link — −1 passes through 0 and vanishes, 2 doubles in size, default −1
options.wide: Not turned on in windows at or below this width (px), default 960
options.targets: Selector to change the diameter, default a, input[type='submit']
options.--fx-dot-a / --fx-dot-b: Two dot gradient colors (css variables), default --kf-ink → --kf-accent

from.where: shared.js cursor dot (.pk-cursor) — original curDot settings (diameter 10·easing 6·scale −1 over a·mix-blend screen·blur 4px·transition .2s)

note: A part that keeps the default cursor and adds one glow dot on top. It uses screen blending, so it shows well on dark backgrounds and is invisible on white — for light skins set --fx-dot-a·b to a dark color and override mix-blend-mode to normal. Not attached on touch devices, under reduced motion or in narrow windows
